headline: Over 3,000 Regain Sight in Trinidad and Tobago Surgery Mission
meta_description: More than 3,000 people in Trinidad and Tobago recovered their vision through free cataract and pterygium surgeries, with demand so high organizers added extra…
summary_short: A surgical mission in Trinidad and Tobago restored sight to over 3,000 people through free cataract and pterygium procedures, with hundreds seeking help daily.
body:
More than 3,000 people in Trinidad and Tobago have regained their sight through a free surgical mission focused on cataract and pterygium removal.

The scale of need became clear as hundreds of patients arrived daily seeking treatment. The overwhelming response forced organizers to set up extra tents to accommodate the flow of people determined not to miss the opportunity for vision-restoring care.

These surgeries address two common eye conditions that can severely impair or eliminate sight. By providing the procedures at no cost, the mission removed a significant financial barrier that often prevents people from accessing essential eye care. The success of the initiative reflects both the depth of unmet medical need in the region and the power of accessible healthcare to transform lives.
